text:
Ryan: FYI billing team flagged many small token charges from reconnect storms in APAC this morning. Looks like quick WS resumes across shards leading to duplicate billing.
Maya: Any concrete traces?
Ryan: Example: trace=tr_401 resume=res-X client=203.0.113.8
  reconnect @ 06:02:01 upstream=10.10.1.4 billed=20
  reconnect @ 06:02:02 upstream=10.10.2.9 billed=18
Akash: Pattern: resume_id same, different upstreams within 1-2s -> meter counts twice. Router started emitting zone-suffixed route tag in last deploy; meter still expects older route format.
Zoe: If dedupe uses (route, resume) it's brittle. We should move to global resume hash for dedupe and not rely on route tag.
Laura: Console aggregates looked weird because UI joins by route tag and lost the link between duplicates. Ops saw per-route billing doubled.
meter-bot: Recent router deploy v2026.04.01 added route.zone.
Akash: Plan: implement meter-side canonicalizer: trim/normalize resume, compute sha1(account+resume) -> 64b key. Two-level dedupe: local LRU cache + Redis fallback with 15s TTL. Feature-flagged.
Ryan: Mitigation first: add a temporary meter-layer filter to canonicalize whitespace and lowercase. Low-risk.
Maya: UX work: add a Console panel showing duplicate_resume_rate by account+route and an annotation for canary. Also surface "resume_id_location" metric (header|query).
Zoe: Edge fix: investigate PONG/close race. Could add a short socket fence token on resume success, but that may be brittle across proxies. Prioritize meter dedupe and route-normalizer.
Akash: Rolling canary: meter-dedupe-v1 -> 5% APAC. Will monitor duplicate_resume_rate and resume_dedupe_miss.
Laura: Billing action: prepare credits for accounts with clear double-billing windows.
Maya: I'll draft an ops note and add the console panel+alert (threshold 0.5% duplicates for 10m).
Ryan: Action items: 1) Akash implement dedupe (flag). 2) Akash add resume_id_location metric. 3) Maya add dashboard+alert+ops note. 4) Zoe open PONG race ticket. 5) Laura coordinate credits.
meter-bot: Canary started: meter-dedupe-v1 -> 5% APAC. Watch metrics in #oncall.
